change_reason: Replace the arbitrary currency penalty with staged lexicographic soft-priority optimization.

common_upstream_roles.trigger: canonical structured notice fixed across all evaluator arms
common_upstream_roles.pricing: deterministic price-zone pricing fixed across all evaluator arms

methods.agent_evaluator_raw_text: LLM interprets raw public operator text; deterministic code scores the schedule
methods.rule_text_evaluator: frozen parser interprets the same public text; deterministic code scores the schedule
methods.structured_evaluator_oracle: receives canonical structured priority as a labelled upper bound
methods.evaluator_removal_control: uses solver and feasibility checks but ignores the qualitative priority

planning_and_accounting.causal_interval_settlement: settle interval t and optimize only t+1 through 48
planning_and_accounting.economics: realized settled prefix plus candidate remaining schedule

rerun_mechanism.name: lexicographic_soft_operational_priority
stages: hold the first-stage optimum and minimize operator-priority slack
hold both earlier optima and optimize the mode-aligned economic objective
rerun_mechanism.unattainable_priority_behavior: retain feasibility and report minimum priority slack

comparison_order: projected full-day economics among compliant schedules
regret relative to the structured oracle
tokens, API cost, latency, CPU, memory, and solver telemetry
